"''But where's the medical station? I don't see anything on my scanners.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano|}} The '''Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2''' was a [[Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]] that served as a [[medcenter]] for the [[Galactic Republic]] and was assigned to the [[12th Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY]], the [[space station]], situated in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[Felucia]], was [[Destruction of the Felucia medical station|destroyed]] by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval]] force. In response to the attack, the Republic dispatched [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], as well as Skywalker's [[Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], to confirm the station's destruction. ==Description== As a [[Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]], constructed and remodified by [[VenteX Construction Yards]] as a [[medcenter]] for the [[Galactic Republic]], the Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2 spanned 651.48 [[meter]]s. Equipped with several [[bacta tank]]s, the station was capable of carrying and revitalizing at least 60,000 wounded [[clone trooper]]s, while also carrying supplies for emergencies. Situated in the [[Thanium sector]] of both the [[Outer Rim Territories]], and [[The Slice|Slice]] regions, the station was located in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]] [[Felucia]] in its [[Felucia system|eponymous star system]], at grid square R-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. ==History== {{Quote|I guess we know what happened to the medical station.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, as the Jedi shuttle comes under attack by Separatist vulture droids|}} At some point, the Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2 was constructed by VenteX Construction Yards for usage as a medical station by the Galactic Republic, during the Clone Wars against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Established sometime later, above the planet Felucia, which had become heavily contested by the conflict due to its strategic proximity to the [[Perlemian Trade Route]],{{BuildFalconCite|21|Guide to the Galaxy}} a major [[super-hyperroute]].{{BuildFalconCite|29|Guide to the Galaxy}} Alongside several other ''Haven''-class medical stations, the medical station was utilized by the [[Republic Military]]'s [[Sector Army|Sector Armies]],{{BuildFalconCite|89|Starship Fact File}} being assigned to the [[12th Sector Army]], whose military campaign against the Confederacy had enveloped Felucia. [[File:FeluciaMedicalStationDestroyed-BH.png|thumb|left|300px|The Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2 is destroyed by the Confederacy navy.]] Later, in [[21 BBY]], sometime after the Republic's [[First Battle of Felucia|defeat]] on Felucia by the Separatists, the Confederacy targeted the medical station. Attacking and destroying it with a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval force]], consisting of a lone [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] accompanied by two [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], the Separatists then proceeded to position an [[Automated vulture droid deployment station|automated deployment station]] for [[Vulture-class starfighter|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]] in Felucia's orbit. Afterward, hearing of the medical station's disappearance, the Republic dispatched [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], as well as Skywalker's [[Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], to investigate. The [[Realspace|space]] station was confirmed to have been destroyed when Tano was unable to detect it on the [[scanner]]s of the Jedi's [[T-6 shuttle]]. While investigating, the Jedi trio discovered the deployment station and crashed on Felucia's surface as their [[shuttle]] was shot down by vulture [[Droid starfighter|droids]]. Afterward, the trio—despite their need to report the station's destruction to the Republic—became involved in a [[Skirmish on Felucia|skirmish]] on the planet's surface against the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang|gang]]. The Jedi were later able to return to the Republic, reporting their discoveries to the government. ==Commanders and crew== The Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2 was operated by a small crew of [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s who oversaw the space station's operations. ==Behind the scenes== The Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2 was introduced in the opening newsreel of "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[April 2]], [[2010]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode217.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bounty Hunters}} It was later identified in ''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'', a [[2019]] supplement to [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' product series. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode217.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bounty Hunters}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/bounty-hunters-episode-guide|text="Bounty Hunters" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{BuildFalconCite|21|Guide to the Galaxy}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|73|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Imo}} *''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' {{1stID|Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2}} *{{DarthVaderCite|12|Galactic Villains}} {{Imo}} *{{DarthVaderCite|18|Galactic Villains}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Felucia Medical Station HCTFF2}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Estación Médica HCTFF2 de Felucia |ja=フェルーシア医療ステーションHCTFF2 }} [[Category:Felucia system locations]] [[Category:Haven-class medical stations]] [[Category:Space stations in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Space stations in the Slice]]
